zh.text: 宾夕法尼亚大学是一所位于美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的私立研究型大学。该校于1740年创立，由本杰明·富兰克林推动建立。学校设有四个本科学院及十二所研究生院和专业学院。主校区位于费城西部的大学城社区，以学院大厅为中心。校园地标包括休斯顿楼和富兰克林球场。

en.text: The University of Pennsylvania is a private research university located in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It was established in 1740 through the efforts of Benjamin Franklin. The institution comprises four undergraduate schools and twelve graduate and professional schools. Its main campus is situated in the University City neighborhood of West Philadelphia. The campus is centered around College Hall and features landmarks such as Houston Hall and Franklin Field.
